catalogCaseStudy.heading: Selected projects.
catalogCaseStudy.intro: A selection of production products and projects built from the interface through to business logic.

lms.title: CostaSpanish LMS
lms.subtitle: Educational management system
lms.description1: An educational management platform that centralizes students, courses, lessons, vouchers, and resources. Following the initial MVP delivery, the academy now uses the system in its day-to-day operations. The product continues to evolve iteratively, with improvements focused on reliability, automation, and user experience.
lms.description2: I have developed the product end to end, covering user experience, authentication and role-based access, data modelling, APIs, external integrations, and the CI/CD pipeline.
lms.alt: CostaSpanish LMS management dashboard shown across multiple devices
lms.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · MongoDB · NextAuth.js · Firebase Storage

academy.title: CostaSpanish Academy
academy.subtitle: Commercial website for a Spanish academy
academy.description1: A commercial website built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to present the academy’s courses and attract new students. It includes bilingual content, technical SEO, database-connected forms, and a conversion-focused responsive experience.
academy.description2: The website is live and continues to evolve alongside the academy’s commercial needs.
academy.alt: Responsive mockup of the CostaSpanish Academy commercial website
academy.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · MongoDB · i18n
